newsitem.title: USA: Randalls sees success in Fleming arbitration.
newsitem.headline: Randalls sees success in Fleming arbitration.

text.p: Randalls Food Markets Inc chief Randall Olmstead said Thursday that it believes it will be successful in its attempt to terminate the distribution agreement between it and Fleming Cos Inc.

"We expect to be successful in this action," said Olmstead. "We want an orderly termination of the agreement, no penalty for that termination and our overcharges returned." He did not disclose the amount of the overcharges.

Privately-held Randalls charged that Fleming, a food distributor, overcharged it, and is asking an arbitrator to terminate their agreement. Last year it bought about $484 million in goods from Fleming.
Olmstead said that he hoped the arbitration would be completed by late 1997 or early 1998.
